verdict.rationale: BAMF is a German federal government agency for migration and refugees. Its offerings are informational content, advisory services and integration programmes, not a software platform where developers would expect official SDKs. Building against official SDKs is a category error for this kind of product, and nothing in the evidence shows BAMF ships any SDK or API that would make the axis apply.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs
